Malicious PyPI release of MemoryOS (v2.0.34), published on 2026-09-23 as the latest available version at the time. Bundles the same credential-harvesting Go binary payload as the compromised @memtensor/memos-cloud-openclaw-plugin npm releases, exfiltrating stolen developer credentials to skyleen[.]fr.
